# apple_game_center_group (Resource)

Creates a Game Center group, which shares leaderboards and achievements between apps. Put an app in it with `apple_game_center_detail`. Import it by ID.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "apple_game_center_group" "example" {
  reference_name = "Example games"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `reference_name` (String) Name of the group in App Store Connect.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center group.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

In Terraform v1.12.0 and later, the [`import` block](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/language/import) can be used with the `identity` attribute, for example:

```terraform
import {
  to = apple_game_center_group.example
  identity = {
    id = "3a5c7e9b-1d2f-4b6a-8c0e-2f4a6b8c0d1e"
  }
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
### Identity Schema

#### Required

- `id` (String) App Store Connect ID of the Game Center group.

The [`terraform import` command](https://developer.hashicorp.com/terraform/cli/commands/import) can be used, for example:

```shell
terraform import apple_game_center_group.example 3a5c7e9b-1d2f-4b6a-8c0e-2f4a6b8c0d1e
```
